hooks.name: Code Review on Write
hooks.description: Quick code review after write operations for security, error handling, and maintainability

action.prompt: Code was just written or modified. Perform a quick review checking for: 1) Common security issues (SQL injection, XSS), 2) Error handling, 3) Code clarity and maintainability, 4) Potential bugs or edge cases. Only comment if you find issues worth addressing.
